column7: evidencesink and siem webhook guards classified with stdlib ip.IsPrivate(), which excludes RFC-6598 CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10, so Alibaba Cloud IMDS 100.100.100.200 was reachable. Fixed by delegating to netutil.IsPrivateOrLinkLocalExceptLoopback; the notifychan and core-channel sites of the same fix are notifychan-webhook-cgnat-001 and channel-ssrf-cgnat-001. Found by the V7 egress-guard parity harness, PR #4143 finding F2
